scope: Historic hotel exterior at Lange Voorhout, rounded entrance, ochre facades and roofline; exclude interior rotunda reconstruction.

quallaSearch.notes: Started with published Qualla story media and the existing local candidate search. Current useful front/rear exteriors require attribution; anonymous historic archive transfers lack sufficient primary creator/release binding and are skipped. The exact two primary1971Anefo records independently bind their rights holder, CC0grant, photographer,date,inventory number and original transfer bytes. Native mapped/public AHNroof controls remain factual geometry controls.

references.commonsTitle: File:Hotel des Indes , Den Haag sluit vandaag, exterieur, Bestanddeelnr 925-0888.jpg

originalReview.notes: Exact full-front native inspected.1971four-storey facade, seven flat window axes plus rounded corner, central three-bay pediment, rusticated base, balcony and entrance hierarchy visible. Roofline is the historical flat/parapet form: this photograph does not certify the later mansard roof, current yellow repaint or modern glazed vestibule.

originalReview.notes: Exact entrance native inspected.1971curved entrance canopy, iron supports, stone piers and recessed glass doors visible. Modern rounded glazed enclosure is not shown; current enclosure geometry and fine ornament remain medium-fi approximations. People, cars, signage and photo pixels are not copied.
